{size=35}I was actually on a date I'd expect it to be more like the real thing{/size},{size=50} so that's a no, sorry.{/size}

Hehe...

Senpai, you're dead serious and it's so creepy. That takes loads off your points...

Why's that?
Well... I'll keep that to myself☆
(Why is she being so coy?)

The kind of day I get chocolate from my mom and sister.
Sorry, I phrased that the wrong way.
Um, let's see... Senpai, you'd be happy to get chocolate, right?
Well, I guess I would...
Right.
Then I think you can expect to get some this year, senpai.
Right, because of the taste-testing event. I'll enjoy tasting and the perks of cleaning up left-overs.
No, that's not what I meant...
No, never mind. I guess I'll keep it to myself, after all. Since I want to see the surprise on your face.
Hikigaya?
(This voice...)

Oh, right. That's a good way to save money.

(I wanna go...)

If you try it, you might find it surprisingly fun. I still have some ingredients left, so wanna try?
Well, I still have some odd jobs to finish, so I'll pass for now.
Right. Then...
Here, senpai. Open your mouth.
Huh? Do I taste test already? With no icing?
This isn't a taste test. It's nutritional support for all the hard work you've done.
Ah, right.
Come on, senpai, open your mouth so I can toss it in.
I can eat it myself, thank you.
...It's great.
Ehehe, the finished product is even better~
Oh? I'm looking forward to it.
Excuse me? I didn't say I'd give you any.
R-right... Sorry, I guess? I got carried away.
Haa-chan, look! I made this!

Did you help, too?
Haa-chan, try them!
So... will you try them? They shouldn't be too bad.

Yay! Haa chan liked them!

Yeah!
Well then, w we'll go back to cleaning up.

I'll try them, then...
How is it?
Wel... It's delicious. It really is.
You know onee san sees through everything~
You're gonna be my brother-in-law, after all~
Hikigaya kun, you don't need to entertain her.

Yes, I'll be right there.
He's here and all, so why not let Hikigaya kun taste it?
Hikigaya?
Hikigaya, you can tell taste??
My taste buds are perfectly fine...
He's got a sweet tooth. I think he's taste testing is trustworthy, at least when it comes to sweetness.
Eh~, for real?
Hmm, alright, if it comes out well, I'll give Hikigaya some, too.
...? What? Something wrong, Isshiki?
N-no, it's just... I was surprised by how popular you seem to be.
Popular? I guess it's just the fact that a lot of the participants know me. People bringing me their chocolates for taste testing here is as proforma as mandatory gifts or new years greetings.
Is that right...?
I don't know about the others, but I let senpai taste my chocolate as a token of my appreciation ☆
(Even if it's just token of appreciation, I'll still taste it. I wonder what kind of sacrifice the men of the world would have to make to get a bargain chocolate from this girl.)
(I'll try the them starting from the left ones.)
(Oh, it's delicious. Perfect amount of sweetness, the aroma is there, too... The handmade look of it is also very appealing to men.)
(Let's try the right ones next...)
(It's kind of powdery, but that doesn't make it bad per say. It has a strange and addictive taste.)
Actually, I made one side, and someone else made the other side.. how were they?
Eh, really?
(Basically, if I guess the ones Iroha made, I'd get praised... I don't know if she'll let me try them again, or if I'll be able to make excuses if I mess up...)
(The homemade left ones, or the nostalgic tasting right ones...)
The left ones.

I honestly don't know which ones are yours, but... I think I like the sweets on the right better. It's somehow a flavour that makes me want to try it again.
The right one...
Eh...
They're so good, they can easily cause a misunderstanding  if you gave them to someone on Valentines.
(If I received them, I'd be the one confessing, not the other way around.)

Well... that's just my impressions at least.
Senpai... as expected of you. Correct, I made the left ones.

Ahaha, I honestly wasn't expecting you to get it right.
Right?

That's right.
What?
Not, it's just, I... thought I'd ask you first.
Thank you for all of your support.
S-Sure thing.

(Eh, what is this affectionate mood I'm getting into...)

I will!

(Your will is so firm, Irohasu...)

Ah, that's what you meant.
Yep, yep.

climbing, home returning gigantor, right?
